title: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Jeskai: The Unknown Way

entities.name: Asham
entities.description: A proud disciple of Cori Mountain Monastery who was defeated by a Temur wanderer and trains for a rematch.

entities.name: Ru
entities.description: An ainok farmer and Asham's childhood friend, who stayed in the village rather than joining the monastery and who cares for Asham after his defeat.

entities.name: Ai Wen
aliases: Ai Wen of the Sahn Ni family
entities.description: A Temur wanderer and elder of the Sahn Ni family who bested Asham in a sparring bout and defeats him again when he challenges her.

entities.name: Master Qi
entities.description: A master at Cori Mountain Monastery whom Asham fears has been angered.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: The former dragonlord of the Jeskai, whose traditions the monastery is no longer bound to.

entities.name: Paipai
entities.description: Ru's family ox, which died the previous winter.

entities.name: Guaiguai
entities.description: The family ox that replaced Paipai.

entities.name: Cori Mountain Monastery
entities.description: A Jeskai monastery of orange and red pagodas beside a caldera lake, where Asham is a disciple.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane, now free of dragonlords.

entities.name: Jeskai
entities.description: The clan whose monks host Ai Wen and whose monasteries now offer free teachings.

entities.name: Temur
entities.description: The northern clan to which Ai Wen belongs.

entities.name: The Way
entities.description: The Jeskai monastic path, which Ru says holds there is more to it than fighting and that one can lose and remain honorable.

entities.name: Cloud-step technique
entities.description: A mana technique that lets a monk run lightly across water.

entities.name: Scorching talon strike
entities.description: A dragon-inspired Jeskai martial form of 'release the self, expel breath, and conjure flames' that Asham struggles to complete.

events.summary: Asham meditates and practices a dragon-inspired flame form on an obsidian outcrop, but no flames come.
Asham relives his humiliating defeat by a Temur fighter, ended in a single strike.
events.quote: The fight, all over in a single strike!

events.summary: Asham tumbles into the lake and is greeted by his old friend Ru.
Asham and Ru play-fight on the lake surface until Ru pulls Asham under.
events.quote: a pair of hands emerged from the surface of the lake and grasped Asham around the ankles, pulling him down.

events.summary: Asham confesses that he lost to the Temur wanderer and believes he let the monastery down.
events.quote: I let the whole monastery down.

events.summary: Asham and Ru argue about Ru having refused the monastery's call, then Asham reveals he wants to learn the final form and win a rematch.
events.quote: You're conflating opportunity with destiny, Asham.

events.summary: Ru tells Asham a loss is not dishonor, then offers to learn the form from him by sparring.
Ai Wen, leaving the mountain happily, eats persimmons and is halted by a monk demanding a rematch.
events.quote: I am Asham of the Cori Mountain Monastery. And I have tracked you down to demand a rematch.

events.summary: Ai Wen refuses the rematch, saying their earlier bout was not a match, and throws Asham off the path into bushes.
events.quote: sent Asham sprawling down the cliffside.

events.summary: Asham conjures dragonfire for the first time and attacks Ai Wen.
events.quote: Asham standing, hands ablaze and held out in a talon pose.

events.summary: Ai Wen defeats Asham, breaking his ribs, and says their first bout was no fair match between an elder and a disciple.
events.quote: a fight between an elder and a disciple is no fair match.

events.summary: Ai Wen praises Asham's pride and breakthrough, and Asham passes out as Ru approaches.
events.quote: I leave you in good hands.

events.summary: Asham wakes in his village home, tended by Ru, who told the monastery he fell down the mountain.
events.quote: I told the monastery you, uh, fell down the mountain,

events.summary: Asham admits that joining the monastery was a way of running away and resolves to visit the other monasteries to broaden his training.
Ru kisses Asham and promises to be there when he returns.
events.quote: And I'll be here when you return,

relations.quote: Only one of us is now an esteemed monk of the Cori Mountain Monastery, after all.

relations.note: childhood friends from the same village
Ru kisses Asham and Asham kisses him back
elder of the Sahn Ni family of Clan Temur
relations.quote: I am Ai Wen, elder of the Sahn Ni family of Clan Temur.

relations.note: defeats him twice though without malice
relations.quote: She thrust a single arm up, grasping Asham by the neck
